origin: hand-written from the published schema; every value invented
notes: The query vocabulary: dimensions, granularities, metrics and filter operators. This vocabulary is account- and time-dependent, so it must be discovered at runtime instead of hard-coded per vendor. metrics[].is_rate is the load-bearing flag - a rate metric is a ratio and must never be summed across buckets or across scopes, while an additive metric may be. The request_count entry follows the published example; synthetic_rate_metric is invented to document the is_rate=true shape without asserting that any particular real metric name exists.
